summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container. Changes: rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py adds an Update class (prologue, algebra). algebra.py translateUpdate returns Update on every path; the empty-request path builds the prologue from q.prologue[0] before early exit. update.py evalUpdate iterates update.algebra. processor.py adds prepareUpdate (records _original_args). __init__.py exports prepareUpdate. New test/test_sparql_prepare.py covers the required behaviors. Nothing was executed per instructions; tests, DAWG tests, and black formatting still need to be run. The initial-bindings test assumes an empty WHERE yields one solution carrying bindings, which is the most likely point to need adjustment. Nothing committed.
